# Cncf Nmstate Reviewer

Review NMstate using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Automation &amp; Configuration category. NMstate is a library with an accompanying command line tool that manages host networking settings in a declarative manner. When used in the Kubernetes environment it allows for declarative node network configuration through the Kubernetes API.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
